title: Rightmove Scraper + New Listings Feed & Alerts, No Phones
seoTitle: Rightmove Scraper — UK Property Listings & Prices
seoDescription: Scrape Rightmove properties for sale and to rent: price, bedrooms, tenure, address, coordinates, price cuts, agent. No phones. $0.80 per 1,000 listings.
notes: Title kept: changed 2026-10-13..15, under measurement. Flat price $0.0008 per property = $0.80 per 1,000, no Actor-start fee. Feed mode exists and is documented (60-day memory, 50,000 items per search, webhook POST, Slack/Discord). All run numbers (1,963 properties in 62 s, about 1,000 listings / 42 pages per search, over 60,000 London listings for sale) are from the current README; the current FAQ has only three substantive questions, so a fourth was taken from its price-changes bullet.
